summary.text: Jamie Isaly is a Democratic member of the Montana House of Representatives from District 58, a retired educator who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Joshua Congleton.

paragraphs.text: Isaly's career experience includes working as a teacher for more than 30 years in the Livingston School District.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Fish, Wildlife and Parks, Education and Business and Labor committees.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
